title: metadata-server: clippy::unnecessary-map-or in metadata.rs:787 fails -D warnings
description:
cargo clippy -p jmap-metadata-server --all-features --tests -- -D warnings fails on:

    error: this map_or can be simplified
       --> crate-jmap-metadata-server/src/metadata.rs:787:13
        |
    787 |             err.get("properties").map_or(true, Value::is_null),

Suggested fix: replace with .is_none_or(Value::is_null). Trivial.

Surfaced while running workspace gate for bd:JMAP-510h.31. Not caused
by that work — pre-existing condition; just newly noticed.
